Retrieve a previously created response

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val apiKey = requireNotNull(System.getenv("API_KEY")) { "API_KEY must be set" }
    val result = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey = apiKey).use { client -> client.retrieveResponse("resp-abc123") }
    println(result.id)
    println(result.status)
}
```
